question: I went to Virtue restaurant & bar in Chicago for my birthday on March 22, 2021 and the main course I had was delicious!  Unfortunately, when I went back about a month later on April 21, it was no longer on the dinner menu.  Using the Wayback Machine, can you help me figure out which main course was on the dinner menu for Virtue on March 22, 2021 but not April 21, 2021? Answer using the singular form, without articles.

Therefore, the main course present on March 22 but not on April 21 is catfish.

mistake_reason: At step 25, Orchestrator asserted the existence of specific archived PDF files for March 22 and April 21, 2021 with precise timestamps and quoted dish text, claiming that the March PDF listed “crispy Mississippi catfish” while the April PDF did not. These URLs and contents were fabricated without being accessed or verified in the browsing steps, and no tool output supported their existence. This hallucinated evidence led the team to the incorrect conclusion (catfish) instead of the true answer (shrimp). This matches FM-4.1: generating factually incorrect information without grounding in tools or data, including invented citations.
